data.batching: Same seed+epoch shuffle for both models; complete batch64, right padding to batch maximum; no splitting, accumulation, packing, truncation or windows; keep last batch.
data.loss: All assistant content, leading newline and end-of-turn EOS; system/user/header/padding labels -100; shifted exactly once.
data.selection: All eligible complete conversations <2048; train uniformly sampled without replacement to half with seed42; full eligible validation unchanged.
data.windowing: One complete conversation per example; no windowing, overlap, truncation or cross-conversation packing.

training.loss_reduction: Mean CE over all supervised tokens in the full batch; MoE adds balance coefficient times the full-batch auxiliary loss; one forward/backward/update per batch.
training.checkpoint_selection: Lowest assistant-token-averaged CE on unchanged full eligible validation after each epoch; no RULER or base reevaluation.
training.optimizer_state: Load original pretraining weights only; fresh FP32 AdamW state and SFT schedule.

recipe_boundary: 2 epochs, cosine and 10% warmup; existing LR=1e-4 and tokenizer; uniform half of eligible train, unchanged eligible validation; full batch64 on one A800 per model.
